item.title: The Almanac 0.4.4
item.description:
• A calmer Settings › Memory. Your name and what you mostly ask about sit at the top, under the Use memory switch. Below them, your memories are two quiet lists with an "＋ Add" at the end of each, and "Forget everything…" is in the footer.
  • Click anywhere else to stop editing a memory: what you typed is saved. Rows line up and keep their size when you start or stop editing, so nothing jumps.
  • If an edit can't be saved (it's too long, say), clicking away keeps your typing and marks the row "Not saved" until you fix or discard it; quitting discards it. Clearing a memory's text puts the old text back; to remove a memory, use Forget or ⌫, and ⌘Z brings it back.
  • In the welcome, the choices now look like the replies they become, on the right, and a choice only shows it's selected once you move with Tab or the arrow keys. Return still picks Yes.
